settings.title: Settings
settings.autoLaunchHelp: Automatically start Voice Key when you log in
settings.audioCaptureRecommendedHint: For radio or speaker playback, turn off both echo cancellation and noise suppression (one alone is often not enough). By default echo cancellation, noise suppression, and AGC are off, similar to a basic OS recorder. Turn them on for calls or heavy echo. Mono keeps size down; 24 kbps is a good default. If you disable 'fallback on constraint failure', recording may fail when constraints are not supported.
settings.audioCaptureBitrateHelp: Lower bitrate means smaller files; too low may hurt recognition. Some Chromium builds ignore custom bitrate.
settings.audioCapturePreferMonoHelp: Smaller files; fine for most speech and ASR.
settings.audioCaptureEchoCancellationHelp: Useful with speakers or noticeable room echo.
settings.audioCaptureNoiseSuppressionHelp: Treats steady room audio as noise; turn off when recording radio or TV through speakers (turning off echo cancellation alone is not enough). Re-enable if speech sounds muffled.
settings.audioCaptureAutoGainControlHelp: Off by default. Turn on if distant speech or speaker/radio playback is too quiet; turn off again if close speech sounds overly boosted.
settings.audioCaptureRadioNoiseMismatch: Echo cancellation is off but noise suppression is still on. Chromium may still strip radio or speaker playback—turn off noise suppression too and save, then try again.
settings.audioCaptureMicFallbackHelp: Recommended on: if the device cannot honor these preferences, it falls back to default capture and greatly reduces push-to-talk start failures. Off is stricter but can fail more often.
settings.storageLinkedToAudioHint: Archived format and size follow 'App preferences' recording settings: Qwen uploads WebM (Opus); GLM path transcodes to MP3 before optional archive upload.
settings.qwenAsrHint: Qwen uses DashScope short-audio synchronous recognition (lower latency). Recordings are WebM (Opus); they must be uploaded to ERPNextCN on the Storage tab to obtain a public HTTPS URL. Each clip must be ≤5 minutes and ≤10 MB. Use a US Model Studio API key when the US region is selected.
settings.qwenSubmitEndpointHelp: Leave empty to use the official DashScope URL for the selected region; if set, this full URL is used for ASR requests.
settings.erpnextcnHelp: After recognition, audio is uploaded here: MP3 for GLM, WebM (Opus) for Qwen. With GLM, upload runs in parallel and failures do not affect recognition. With Qwen, upload must succeed to obtain a public URL. Leave host empty to use the default URL in the placeholder.
settings.durationWarning: Note: Maximum duration for single voice input is 30 seconds.
settings.apiEndpointHelp: Leave empty to use the default URL for the selected region; if set, this URL is used for ASR requests.
